slides.title: Hallboys context — what we are designing for
left_points: Acumatica is the system of record (AP, project, schedule)
3-person IT team — capacity for configuration, not custom build
One AP clerk processing every invoice end-to-end
Active Claude usage already exists across estimating, ops, finance
right_points: Acumatica unchanged — no replacement, no integration risk
No headcount reduction — capacity expansion only
No black-box automation; humans approve every AP post, schedule change, closeout sign-off
All data stays in the Hallboys Claude workspace

slides.title: What we estimate Hallboys leaks per year on the four workflows
slides.stat_label: $78K quote comparison + $95K schedule conflicts + $62K closeout drag + 'AP capacity ceiling — Not available, week-1 audit'. Math on next slide.
slides.body: We removed the AP $45K estimate — it depended on assumptions we cannot defend without your invoice data. We will replace it with a real number from a week-1 audit, or remove the AP workflow from scope.

slides.title: Where the leak comes from — math on the slide
rows: 1.5 idle crew days/qtr × $5,400/day blended (8-person × 8 hrs × $84/hr loaded)
1 mid-size closeout/qtr × 18 days × $1M retainage tied × 8% cost-of-capital
AP clerk OT or seasonal hire deferred at +60% volume — too many assumptions to defend pre-audit

slides.title: How work happens today, and where it fails
slides.body: Two workflows we will pilot live. Two we will run shadow-only or hold.

slides.title: Today — pilot Workflow A: Quote comparison
left_points: Estimator opens 3-5 sub PDFs, hand-builds Excel comparison: 4 hrs per package
Catches missing line items by chance during scroll-through
13 multi-vendor packages last quarter = ~52 hrs absorbed by 1 estimator
Q4 2025 illustrative example: Westside MOB package, 4 sub bids
right_points: Estimator drops PDFs into Quote-Comparison skill
Skill returns scope deltas, missing line items, unit-price outliers
Estimator reviews in ~1 hr, picks the winner — no Excel build
Same illustrative package: estimator finishes by 9:30, picks up another package same day

slides.title: Today — pilot Workflow B: Closeout document checks
left_points: PM assembles closeout from shared drives, ~3 hrs
Owner finds gaps (lien-pay-app mismatches, missing warranties)
Recent illustrative case: 4 lien gaps, 1 warranty letter missing, retainage held 18 days past expected
PM chases docs from subs already off the job
right_points: PM uploads closeout folder to Closeout-Check skill before sending
Skill checks against the Hallboys closeout SOP — flags gaps before owner sees them
Same illustrative case: gaps found in 1 hour; PM fixes in 2 days, sends clean package
Retainage releases on schedule; ~$15,500 in cost-of-capital recovered on this single job

slides.title: Today — shadow Workflow C and held Workflow D
slides.left_header: Workflow C: AP exception triage (shadow only)
left_points: Today: clerk opens each invoice cold, posts in Acumatica, no anomaly scan
Pilot mode: shadow for 30 days — Claude pre-reads each invoice, the clerk's workflow does not change yet
We measure extraction accuracy + would-have-flagged anomalies
Production switch only after >85% accuracy and clerk endorsement — Claude never writes to Acumatica
slides.right_header: Workflow D: Equipment + crew schedule scan (held)
right_points: Today: scheduler reconciles weekly schedule by hand
Pilot mode: held — Acumatica schedule data quality must be confirmed first
Why held: false-positive risk is high if the schedule data is stale; we don't pitch what we can't measure
Reopen this workflow at day 60 if schedule data audit is clean

rows: Builds 2-3 Excel comparisons by hand, ~10 hrs
Reviews 2-3 pre-built comparisons, ~3 hrs; runs +1 package/wk
Estimator picks every winner; rejects skill output anytime
Assembles closeout package, owner finds gaps, retainage delay
Pre-checks with skill, fixes in-house, sends clean
PM signs every closeout; skill is advisory only
Same workflow during pilot; receives anomaly report at end of day, gives feedback
No production change in pilot — workflow unchanged
Owns 2 published skills + 1 shadow; monthly skill review
IT approves every skill version before publish

slides.title: Failure modes — per workflow, what happens when it breaks
rows: Misses scope nuance on unusual trades
Estimator spot-checks every package; weekly review log
Estimator + IT lead at monthly skill review
Misses doc not covered by Hallboys SOP
PM adds the missed item to skill backlog; SOP versioned
PM + IT lead in next monthly review
Mis-extracts a field or flags legitimate invoice as duplicate
Logged for skill update; no posting blocked, no clerk workflow change
IT lead; clerk feedback drives prioritization
False-positive conflict from stale Acumatica data
Held until Acumatica schedule data audit completes
Scheduler + IT lead before any pilot start

slides.title: Quantified pilot upside — live workflows only
slides.stat_label: $78K (quote comparison) + $62K (closeout). Single number, derived on slide 4. Updated from real Hallboys baseline in week 1.
slides.body: Schedule and AP are not in this number. Either they prove themselves in shadow/audit, or they don't get pitched in this pilot.

slides.title: 60-day pilot — 2 live, 1 shadow, 1 held
rows: <3 real missing items across first 5 closeouts
Reopen at day 60 if Acumatica schedule data audit is clean

slides.title: Pilot plan — what happens when, who does what
left_points: Day 1-7: lead estimator pulls last quarter's bid log (3 packages min for baseline)
Day 1-7: PM provides current closeout SOP
Day 1-7: AP clerk + IT allow 30 days of historical invoices for shadow benchmark
Day 30 + Day 60: Sarat attends 30-min scorecard reviews
IT lead: skill ownership at day 60 handover
right_points: Day 1-14: build Quote-Comparison + Closeout-Check skills in your workspace
Day 8-21: re-run baselines on the bid packages and prior closeouts; deliver baseline scorecard
Day 22-60: live pilot with 1 estimator + 1 PM; weekly 1-page scorecard
Day 30 + Day 60: review meetings; honest go/no-go recommendation
Day 60: skills handed to IT, AP shadow report, schedule reopen recommendation

slides.title: Next step — 30-min baseline-data check this week
slides.body: Lead estimator + one PM. Confirm bid log accessible, confirm closeout SOP exists. If yes, pilot starts day 8. If no, we re-scope before any commitment.
